question.text: Under Ch 11.10 Code of Conduct, AIFs should disclose the name of all their Key Management Personnel (KMP) and the investment manager:

answer.text: In the Private Placement Memorandum, and any change in KMP shall be intimated to investors and SEBI
Only to SEBI, not to investors
On the public website within 24 hours of appointment

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Ch 11.10 (Code of Conduct), AIFs should disclose the name of all their KMP and the investment manager IN THE PPM. Any change in KMP shall be intimated to investors and SEBI. This creates both onboarding disclosure and ongoing change-disclosure duty. **The Trap:** Options A and C understate the disclosure. Option D (website disclosure) is not the regulation. **Cross-Exam Context:** Ongoing KMP disclosure tested in X-A/X-B and XXI-A (PMS Distributor) as well. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Update the PPM KMP Annexure whenever KMP change — many managers forget the annexure and are flagged in SEBI audits for the PPM being out-of-date on KMPs.
